answer: Each attempt carries 120 stamped dockets, each costing £22 to have checked, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. A name without Saltpanbound salt inspector brine licence is turned away at the counter, and a licence salt inspectors renew after inspection room reviews is the reason the counter can tell. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The beacon is on the docket. lantern is written on the receipt. One prism, one entry.
